mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 5.0%, improving labor market conditions, this triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not fall below 5.0% or 5d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDP (demand) and industrial production (supply) indicate robust economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: The two proxies do not move concurrently or 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion, 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS declining.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE stops declining or reverses, or 5d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.5%, this labor market improvement triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The unemployment rate does not fall below 4.5% or 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in GDP (demand) and industrial production (supply) reflect robust economic growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both increase in the same month
failure_condition: The two proxies do not move concurrently or 60d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary easing cycle (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%), sustained GDP growth (GDPC1) signals economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In a monetary easing cycle, 20d returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) despite FEDFUNDS < 2.0% and GDPC1 rising.
